name: Kirkland Signature Meatloaf with Yukon Gold Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Tender ground beef and pork meatloaf topped with a sweet tomato glaze paired with smooth, peeled Yukon Gold mashed potatoes. The mashed potatoes are very gentle; the meatloaf contains moderate onion and breadcrumbs requiring good baseline digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake as directed until hot. The mashed potatoes are the safest component; eat moderate slices of meatloaf and avoid extra spicy barbecue additions.
